old='''    @staticmethod
    def shift_right(source, shift):
        words, bits = divmod(shift, 64)
        result = np.zeros_like(source)
        if words >= len(source):
            return result
        if bits == 0:
            result[:len(source)-words] = source[words:]
        else:
            end = len(source)-words
            result[:end] = source[words:end] >> bits
            if end > 1:
                result[:end-1] |= source[words+1:] << (64-bits)
        return result
'''
new='''    @staticmethod
    def shift_right(source, shift):
        # Shift independently inside every 128-bit row lane.  A flat shift
        # would let the first coordinate of the next row become a late start
        # in the preceding row.
        result = np.zeros_like(source)
        if shift == 0:
            return source.copy()
        if shift < 64:
            result[0::2] = source[0::2] >> shift
            result[0::2] |= source[1::2] << (64-shift)
            result[1::2] = source[1::2] >> shift
        else:
            result[0::2] = source[1::2] >> (shift-64)
        return result
'''
assert old in s
open(p,'w').write(s.replace(old,new))
